derivation.fast_balanced_cycle_center: h_bar approximately (gamma_plus-gamma_minus)/(gamma_plus+gamma_minus), for equal per-polarity throughput and small pulse exponents
derivation.effective_terminal_slope: Ignoring relaxed RC terms at fixedT near that cycle center: dV/dt approximately I/(3600Q)*[-b+2H*gamma_plus*gamma_minus/(gamma_plus+gamma_minus)]
